notes: Only physical store: Warszawa, Homepark Targowek (Malborska 47). Delivery from sportano.pl/dostawa: Paczkomat/ORLEN/DPD Pickup/DPD courier free above 299 zl, InPost courier 9.99 above 299. Product JSON-LD lists shippingRate 7.99 - cheapest method may be 7.99 in cart; not confirmed. Newsletter code: value 50 zl off orders over 499 zl, from the signup block on every sportano.pl page; the newsletter regulamin (from 2026-09-18) does not describe the code at all, so validity period and whether it works on already-reduced prices are not published (an older 2023 RABAT50 leaflet code of the same value excluded reduced items). Getting it: subscribe with e-mail on sportano.pl, tick consent, click the activation link; code arrives by e-mail; must be logged in to a Sportano account at checkout. Can it replace BLACKDEALS? Yes as an alternative, not in addition: BLACKDEALS reg. pt 13 and the newsletter note both say promotions do not combine (whether the cart technically accepts two codes was not tested). Use the newsletter/APP code only if the basket is over 499/399 zl and the BLACKDEALS savings on marked items are below 50/40 zl. BLACKDEALS reduces the 'obowiazujaca cena' (current price, often already crossed out), so check each item's Omnibus 'Najnizsza cena' - many code prices equal or exceed the 30-day low.
